meta.name: cellxgene-census
meta.description: Query the CZ CELLxGENE Census programmatically for versioned public single-cell and spatial transcriptomics data. Use when you need population-scale cell metadata, gene expression slices, Census summary counts, source H5AD URIs/downloads, embeddings, spatial Census data, or reference atlas comparisons across organisms, tissues, diseases, assays, and cell types. For analyzing your own local single-cell data use scanpy, anndata, or scvi-tools.

copy.tagline: 检索公开的单细胞与空间转录组数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在做单细胞或空间转录组研究想直接从公开图谱获取数据
copy.tagline_en: Query public single-cell and spatial transcriptomics data on demand
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you study single-cell biology and want to query public transcriptomics atlases directly.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude能用Python查询CZ CELLxGENE Census的公共单细胞与空间转录组数据：按细胞类型、组织、疾病、物种等筛选，返回基因表达、细胞元数据、汇总统计、H5AD源文件链接等，并可衔接Scanpy分析。
howto.when: 当用户需要查询Census中的公共单细胞/空间转录组数据，如细胞元数据、基因表达或汇总统计等时触发。

say.text: 查询人类肺组织B细胞有多少种。
say.note: 返回按细胞类型分组的计数结果。

say.text: 获取小鼠大脑中FOXP2基因的表达数据。
say.note: 返回基因表达矩阵与元数据。

say.text: 对比人类与小鼠肝脏的细胞类型构成。
say.note: 返回两物种的对比汇总。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use Python to query the CZ CELLxGENE Census for public single-cell and spatial transcriptomics data, filter by cell type, tissue, disease, organism, etc., and return gene expression, metadata, summary counts, H5AD source links, or integrate with Scanpy.
howto.when_en: When the user needs to query public single-cell or spatial transcriptomics data from the Census, such as cell metadata, gene expression, or summary counts.

say_en.text: How many B-cell types are there in human lung tissue?
say_en.note: Returns counts grouped by cell type.

say_en.text: Get FOXP2 gene expression data in mouse brain.
Compare cell-type composition of human and mouse liver.
